Switch Control-specific listing vocabulary — what translates differently

Switch-access marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese buyers describe Switch Control workflows — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Switch Control vs AssistiveTouch vs Voice Control

US pages use "Switch Control", "Switch access", or "Adaptive switches." China storefront copy often uses 切换控制 for Apple's Accessibility feature name, 外部开关 for external switch hardware, 自适应开关 for adaptive switch products, or 扫描 for scanning highlight modes — depending on whether you mean system Switch Control, in-app switch-access layouts, or switch recipe libraries. AppLocale aligns phrasing with your actual switch-access scope and avoids conflating Switch Control with 辅助触控 (AssistiveTouch floating menu) or 声音控制 (Voice Control spoken commands) when your screenshots show external switches and scanning highlights, not floating buttons or numbered voice overlays.

External switches vs platform switches

Screenshot galleries may label Bluetooth adaptive switches (外部开关 / 自适应开关) separately from platform switch sources like screen tap or head movement. Buyers searching for motor-accessibility apps distinguish dedicated switch hardware from generic touch alternatives — match what your English listing and screenshots actually show.

Auto-scan vs manual scan vs point scan

Scanning modes (自动扫描, 手动扫描, 定点扫描) look different from Voice Control numbered overlays or VoiceOver focus rings. Do not use 旁白 (VoiceOver) or 声音控制 (Voice Control) vocabulary on frames that show switch scanning highlight rings unless that is what the screenshot depicts.

Switch recipes vs App Shortcuts

Switch recipes (切换控制功能) assign multi-step actions to switch presses under Switch Control settings. App Shortcuts and App Intents run automations via Siri or the Shortcuts app — different buyer intent and screenshot vocabulary from switch recipe editors.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need switch-access search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 切换控制, 外部开关, and 扫描 each signal different intent from AssistiveTouch, Voice Control, or VoiceOver keywords.

Caption lines vs burned-in badges

Marketing screenshot overlays you control — "Switch Control" headlines on gallery frames — are separate caption fields or burned-in PNG text. See Screenshot captions in Simplified Chinese for caption-field mechanics when overlays are editable in Connect.

Switch Control feature launches and switch recipe library updates often land in the 170-character promotional text field above the description — updatable without a new binary.   • Inconsistent vocabulary between listing description, promotional text, and screenshot captions when all three mention Switch Control or switch access
